turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Hello! How may I help you?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Hello! My name is Chloe. I'm reaching out today to inquire about the status of my package. The tracking said it was delivered but I have not received it.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Sure! May I have your full name?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes, my name is Chloe Zhang.

turns.speaker: system
turns.text: Account has been pulled up for Chloe Zhang.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you, Chloe.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: If you could review the order status I would appreciate it.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: May I now have Username, Email and Order ID in order to see the order?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Sure! My username is cz477514. My email address is: cz477514@gmail.com and my Order ID is 1442889983

turns.speaker: system
turns.text: Purchase validation in progress ...

turns.speaker: system
turns.text: Querying the system for an answer ...

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: It seems this was an error on our part and it has not yet come. How long have you been waiting for it?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: That is sad news. I have been waiting for 5 days now.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: It usually is not considered missing or late until past a week. It should come any day now.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: If not we can replace it for you.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: At this point I am concerned as this is highly unusual. It would be most appreciated if you could arrange a replacement shipment.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I am sorry, I cannot do so until it has been over a week. The email you got that it came was also shown to be incorrect by our system.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: If you could wait just a few more days it should arrive.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I see, is there a way an exception could be made?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: If the missing package ever arrives I will be sure to send it back, at least this way I can be sure of it.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: It's telling our system you should still get it any-day now. I cannot issue a new order at this time.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Very sorry.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Is there anything else I can help you with today?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I understand, no worries. I hope it arrives! I have no further questions today.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Thank you for your patience.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you! Have a good day!
